title: Official Latest NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com

retrieval_method.note: The sandbox shell egress allowlist refuses the TLS handshake to www.nfl.com (curl error 35 SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL), so the official page is read with the agent's page-fetch tool and the fetched body is written to disk verbatim. A hash proves the bytes were not altered after retrieval; it does not prove the page content is a complete census of the week.

files.role: verbatim body of the official injury report at retrieval time
verbatim official NFL.com news items displayed on the injury page at retrieval time

scope_observed.note: The official page listed 14 games / 28 teams at retrieval time. A full NFL week has 16 games / 32 teams, so 4 teams were absent from the page. This is recorded as an observation, not inferred as 'no injuries'.

verification: official; row-level statuses are transcribed verbatim from the cited page
